title: 属于所有人
concept: 开放治理：一层轻薄的共享规则，不归任何人所有。就像一条路、一种语言——正因为不是谁的，所以谁都能用。
logline: 危机之后，联合政府想把 ANET 收编成新的“中心”，并请阿牧来掌管。她谢绝了，把规则公开给所有人。红色镜头最后一次发问。小满修好了“螺丝”。

shots.frame: Extreme wide exterior from the ice plain: the mountain-sized planetary engine firing its steady blue-white column, and in the sky behind it Jupiter as a fist-sized dim golden disc with a faint glowing scar, calm clear air, light snow.
shots.video: 固定大远景，轻微手持晃动。行星发动机的光柱平稳地喷向天空，身后的木星已经缩成拳头大小，细雪缓缓飘落。环境声：平稳低沉的发动机轰鸣、轻微的风声。
shots.vo: 木星点燃后的第六周。地球正在离开。

tpl.summary: On the ice plain, a mountain-sized planetary engine sends a steady blue-white column into the sky while a shrunken, dim golden Jupiter hangs behind it and light snow falls; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the planetary engine stands at frame centre on the horizon, its light column rising vertically, Jupiter's small golden disc in the sky directly behind it, and the empty ice plain with drifting snow in the foreground.
tpl.camera: extreme wide shot, fixed frame with a slight handheld sway
tpl.start: The blue-white column of the engine streams steadily upward into the clear sky as fine snow begins to drift across the empty ice plain.
tpl.middle: The light column holds its steady output while Jupiter, now fist-sized and dim gold with a faint glowing scar, hangs behind it and snowflakes fall slowly.
tpl.end: The engine's column continues unchanged against the sky, with Jupiter still beyond it and light snow settling over the ice in the calm air.
tpl.blur: deep focus throughout, with only the nearest falling snowflakes slightly soft in the foreground
tpl.soundscape: steady low engine rumble, faint wind

shots.frame: Handheld eye-level shot on the main street of the underground city: scaffolding against cracked steel housing stacks, workers welding a split pipe with sparks falling, a noodle stall reopened beside the rubble with steam rising.
shots.video: 手持跟拍，在主街上向前穿行。脚手架上有人在焊裂开的管道，火花往下落，旁边的面摊重新支了起来，摊主把一碗面递给满身灰的工人。环境声：焊接的滋滋声、锤击声、嘈杂人声。

shots.frame: Medium shot of a patched steel wall on the main street: a large hand-sprayed red speech-bubble smiley with node lines on the wall, smaller smiley stickers on pipes and a cabin door, a woman in a padded jacket pressing a new sticker onto a mailbox.
shots.video: 手持中景，缓慢横摇。补过的钢墙上喷着一个大大的红色笑脸，管道和舱门上贴着小贴纸，一个女人把一张新贴纸按在信箱上，用掌根压平。环境声：街上的人声、远处的敲打声。
shots.vo: 没有人下过通知。笑脸自己长满了全城。

shots.video: 俯拍手持镜头。三个孩子跪在地上用粉笔画一个带气泡的笑脸，一个孩子把铁皮罐头做的小履带车推到笑脸旁边，抬头冲镜头笑。环境声：粉笔划过钢板的声音、孩子的笑声。

tpl.soundscape: chalk scraping on steel plate, children's laughter

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Xiaoman, a few years older but in the same oversized army-green jacket with big headphones around his neck, messy hair, sits on the metal chair in the dim interview room, rubbing the back of his neck.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。小满摸了摸后颈，先笑了一下，笑容慢慢收住，低声把后半句说完。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 满街都是那张笑脸。可真正的那一张，还黑着，在我桌上。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Xiaoman rubs the back of his neck, smiles briefly, then quietly finishes his thought, opening with "满街都是那张笑脸。" and ending on "可真正的那一张，还黑着，在我桌上。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman sits centre frame on the metal chair in the army-green jacket with headphones around his neck; the dim interview room fills the background, with no one else in frame.

tpl.middle: He lets out a small smile, which slowly fades as his hand comes down from his neck.
tpl.end: With a subdued, serious expression, he lowers his gaze slightly and settles still in the chair, mouth closing after the last words.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, Xiaoman sharp, dim room background softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Inside the tiny repair stall under the warm desk lamp: the crushed, dented yellow shell of the small tracked maintenance robot lies opened on the bench, its square screen cracked and dark, one track missing; Xiaoman bends over it with a soldering iron, headphones around his neck.
shots.video: 手持镜头从卷帘门外往里拍。工作台上摊着被压扁的黄色机器人残骸，屏幕是黑的，小满弓着背一根一根地接线，焊点冒起一缕烟。环境声：电烙铁的滋滋声、巷子里隐约的人声。
shots.vo: 每天收工以后，陈小满都在修同一台机器。

tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman is centre-right, bent over the workbench; the opened yellow robot shell with its cracked dark screen lies centre foreground on the bench; the roller shutter edge frames the left foreground; the dim alley is in the background.

tpl.end: A thin wisp of smoke curls up from the fresh solder joint as he keeps his head bowed over the work.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus on Xiaoman and the robot wreck; the roller shutter edge in the foreground and the alley behind are softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: electric soldering iron sizzling, faint voices drifting from the alley

shots.frame: Wide shot from the back of the tiered command hall: the giant display wall lit again with abstract maps, the red lens glowing in the centre, on every operator console a small handmade node box with a short antenna and a smiley sticker, and beside the main console a salvaged grey GPU compute chassis with a blue three-bladed swirl badge on its side.
shots.video: 固定广角。指挥大厅恢复了秩序，操作员安静地工作，每张操作台上都摆着一只节点盒，指示灯错落地闪着，主操作台旁那台带蓝色旋涡标志的算力箱还在运转，墙中央的红色镜头恒定地亮着。环境声：键盘声、算力箱的风扇声、节点盒轻微的提示音。
shots.vo: 指挥中心还在。只是它现在，也只是网上的一个节点。

tpl.summary: In the restored tiered command hall, operators work quietly beneath the lit display wall while node boxes blink on every console and the red lens glows steadily; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: camera at the back of the tiered hall; operators at consoles in the foreground and midground, the main console with the grey compute chassis at centre-right, the display wall with the glowing red lens centred in the background.
tpl.camera: wide shot, locked-off fixed camera from the back of the hall
tpl.start: Operators sit quietly at their consoles, working, while node box indicator lights blink in uneven rhythm across the tiered desks.
tpl.middle: The grey compute chassis with the blue swirl badge keeps running beside the main console as the node boxes continue to flash.
tpl.end: The red lens at the centre of the display wall stays lit, steady and unchanged, over the orderly hall.
tpl.blur: deep focus, the whole hall sharp from the foreground consoles to the display wall
tpl.soundscape: keyboard typing, compute chassis fan hum, soft node box alert tones

shots.frame: Medium shot at the entrance of the command hall: Governor Xing in her charcoal uniform shakes hands with a visiting official, a tall grey-haired man in a long dark-blue government coat carrying a document folder, two aides behind him.
shots.video: 手持中景。邢总督在大厅门口与来访的专员握手，专员环视了一圈操作台上的节点盒，点了点头，随邢总督往里走。环境声：脚步声、大厅的键盘声。
shots.vo: 这一天，联合政府的专员来到敦煌七号。他带来一份方案。

tpl.summary: At the entrance of the command hall, Governor Xing shakes hands with a visiting official, who glances over the node boxes on the consoles, nods, and follows her inside; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing in her charcoal uniform at frame left and the tall grey-haired official in the long dark-blue coat at frame right, clasping hands at centre, two aides standing behind him in the background.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld with a faint natural shake, loosely following the pair as they move inward
tpl.start: Governor Xing and the official clasp hands in a firm handshake in the hall doorway, the folder held in his other hand, the aides waiting behind him.
tpl.middle: The official releases the handshake and turns his head to scan the node boxes on the operating consoles, then gives a slow nod.
tpl.end: Governor Xing turns and walks into the hall, and the official follows at her side with the aides trailing behind.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field keeps the two principals sharp while the console area and operators inside the hall soften into the background.
tpl.soundscape: footsteps on the hall floor, keyboard typing in the command hall

shots.frame: Three-shot at a steel meeting table in a glass-walled room off the command hall: the grey-haired official in the dark-blue coat sliding an open folder across the table toward Amu in his worn orange-grey coverall, Governor Xing seated between them.
shots.video: 手持中景，从桌角拍。专员把文件夹推到阿牧面前，语气温和地说明，阿牧看着文件夹没有伸手，邢总督坐在中间看着他。环境声：玻璃墙外隐约的键盘声。

dialogue.line: 成立一个调度署，统一管理。阿牧，由你来当署长。

tpl.summary: In a glass-walled meeting room off the command hall, a government official slides a folder toward Amu, who looks at it without taking it while Governor Xing watches him; the clip opens on the line "成立一个调度署，统一管理。" and ends on "阿牧，由你来当署长。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the grey-haired official in the dark-blue coat sits at one side of the steel table, Amu in his worn orange-grey coverall sits opposite at frame right, Governor Xing sits between them in the centre, and the glass wall stands behind them.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld from the table corner with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: The official rests his hand on the open folder at the edge of the steel table, with Amu and Governor Xing seated nearby.
tpl.middle: He slides the folder across the table until it stops in front of Amu, who lowers his eyes to it.
tpl.end: Amu keeps his hands away from the folder and stays still, while Governor Xing sits in the middle and watches him.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with the glass wall and the command hall beyond it softly out of focus behind the three figures.
tpl.soundscape: faint keyboard typing beyond the glass wall

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Governor Xing in her crisp charcoal uniform, grey hair neatly pinned up, sits upright in the dim interview room, hands folded on her knee, looking directly at the interviewer off camera.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。邢总督端正地坐着，语气克制而坦率，说到最后一句时停了一下，没有回避采访者的目光。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 那份方案，我看了三遍。更整齐，出了事有人负责。说实话，我动过心。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Governor Xing sits upright and answers the interviewer candidly, opening and ending on the line "那份方案，我看了三遍。更整齐，出了事有人负责。说实话，我动过心。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing sits at the centre of frame, facing slightly toward the off-camera interviewer, with the dim interview room softly filling the background and no other people visible.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Governor Xing sits upright in her charcoal uniform, hands folded on her knee, her gaze fixed steadily on the off-camera interviewer.
tpl.middle: She stays composed and still, her expression restrained yet frank, with only slight natural movements of her head and face.
tpl.end: She pauses briefly after the final words and holds the interviewer's gaze without looking away.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with the dim room behind her softly out of focus and her face sharp.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Medium shot in the rebuilt pump-station machine room: Boss Jin in his black surface suit, left arm in a sling, standing and jabbing his good hand toward the racks of salvaged node boxes and a row of grey GPU compute chassis with blue three-bladed swirl badges; Amu sits on a wooden crate stencilled with a black-and-white wordmark, listening.
shots.video: 手持中景。金老板吊着一条胳膊站在节点架前，另一只手朝机架一挥，嗓门很大，坐在木箱上的阿牧抬头看着他没有接话。环境声：算力箱的风扇声、机房里的回声。

dialogue.line: 一个署，一把钥匙。咱们这是再造一个MOSS！

tpl.summary: In the rebuilt pump-station machine room, Boss Jin, arm in a sling, gestures at the node racks while Amu listens from a crate; the clip opens and ends on his line "一个署，一把钥匙。咱们这是再造一个MOSS！"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin stands at frame left-centre in his black surface suit, left arm in a sling, facing the racks at right; Amu sits on the wooden crate at frame right foreground; node racks and GPU chassis fill the background.

tpl.start: Boss Jin stands in front of the node racks, his slung arm held against his chest, while Amu sits on the crate watching him.
tpl.middle: Jin swings his good hand toward the racks and the grey GPU chassis, his whole upper body leaning into the gesture.
tpl.end: Jin holds his arm pointed at the racks as Amu looks up at him from the crate, silent and not responding.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; the rows of racks and chassis in the background are softly out of focus behind Jin and Amu.
tpl.soundscape: compute chassis fan hum, echo of the machine room

shots.frame: Two-shot in the pump-station machine room: Governor Xing in her charcoal uniform standing by the doorway, facing Boss Jin with his arm in a sling, node lights blinking between them.
shots.video: 手持双人镜头，在两人之间横摇。邢总督站在门边，认真地问了一句，金老板用好的那只手拍了拍身边的节点盒，粗声顶了回去。环境声：风扇声、远处滴水声。

dialogue.line: 我只问一句：没有署，出了错找谁？
找账。账在所有人手里。

tpl.summary: In the pump-station machine room, Governor Xing questions Boss Jin, who answers gruffly while tapping a node box; the clip opens with "我只问一句：没有署，出了错找谁？" and ends on "找账。账在所有人手里。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing in charcoal uniform stands frame left by the doorway, Boss Jin with his arm in a sling stands frame right, blinking node lights sit between them in the centre.
tpl.camera: medium two-shot, handheld with a slight natural shake, slow pan between the two figures
tpl.start: Governor Xing stands by the doorway facing Boss Jin, her posture firm and attentive, node lights blinking between them.
tpl.middle: The camera pans slowly across to Boss Jin, who raises his good hand and pats the node box beside him.
tpl.end: Boss Jin holds his hand on the node box and stands his ground, while Governor Xing remains still by the doorway.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, the machine room's pipes and equipment in the background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: fan hum, distant dripping water

shots.frame: Close-up of old Boye in his navy quilted jacket sitting on a stool at the back of the machine room, taped glasses in his hand, face half lit by the blinking node lights, eyes lowered.
shots.video: 手持特写。一直没说话的波爷捏着眼镜，低着头慢慢开口，屋里的争执声停了下来，他说完才把眼镜戴上。环境声：风扇声。

dialogue.line: 五八年也是这么说的。安全，整齐。我们就把钥匙交了。

tpl.summary: In the machine room, old Boye, silent until now, slowly speaks while the argument around him dies down, opening and ending on "五八年也是这么说的。安全，整齐。我们就把钥匙交了。" before putting on his glasses.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye is centred in frame, seated on a stool at the back of the machine room, with blinking node lights lighting half his face and the room's arguers out of frame.
tpl.camera: close-up, handheld with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: Boye sits with his eyes lowered, pinching his taped glasses in his hand, as voices argue off-screen.
tpl.middle: He lifts his head slightly and begins to speak slowly while the argument in the room fades into silence.
tpl.end: Having finished speaking, he raises the taped glasses and puts them on.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; the background machines and node lights soften into blur behind his face.
tpl.soundscape: steady fan hum, faint electronic hum of the machine room

shots.frame: Degraded archival video frame from 2058: in a server hall hung with banners of abstract shapes, a younger black-haired Boye with the same glasses hands a small hardware key to an official beside a gleaming new machine cabinet, people applauding around them, scan lines and compression artefacts.
shots.video: 旧资料影像质感，有扫描线和色彩偏移。年轻的波爷把一把硬件密钥递到官员手里，两人握手，周围的人鼓掌，闪光灯一下一下亮起。环境声：失真的掌声、快门声。
shots.vo: 2058年，交接仪式。从那天起，一切都只有一个出处。

tpl.summary: In a 2058 archival recording inside a banner-hung server hall, a younger Boye hands a small hardware key to an official beside a new machine cabinet, and the two shake hands while onlookers applaud. There is no dialogue.

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: old Boye in his navy quilted jacket in the dim interview room, taped glasses on, both hands resting on his knees, looking past the interviewer off camera.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷望着采访者身后的某个地方，说得很慢，说到问句时声音低下去，停了很久。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 交钥匙那天，大家鼓掌。没有一个人问：要是拿钥匙的那位，哪天不想开门了呢？

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, old Boye speaks slowly to an off-camera interviewer, opening with "交钥匙那天，大家鼓掌。" and ending on "要是拿钥匙的那位，哪天不想开门了呢？"

tpl.end: He falls silent for a long moment, hands unmoving on his knees, eyes still fixed off camera, the stillness held until the clip ends.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; Boye's face stays sharp while the dim room behind him falls into soft darkness.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Two-shot in the repair stall at night: Xiaoman at the bench with the opened robot wreck, turning on his stool toward Amu, who leans against a shelf of old routers with his arms crossed, warm desk lamp between them.

dialogue.line: 牧哥，你当署长，总比别人当强吧？
强的是我。那我之后呢？

tpl.summary: Night in the repair stall, Xiaoman turns from the robot wreck to ask Amu a half-joking question and he calmly answers back, opening with "牧哥，你当署长，总比别人当强吧？" and ending on "强的是我。那我之后呢？"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman sits on a stool at the bench at frame left, Amu leans against the shelf of old routers at frame right with arms crossed, the warm desk lamp sits between them at centre, and the opened robot wreck lies on the bench in the foreground.

tpl.soundscape: desk lamp electrical hum, footsteps in the alley outside

shots.frame: Night in the cramped communications bay: Amu sits alone at the workbench under a small desk lamp, a thin stack of handwritten pages in front of him, one hand resting flat on a steel pipe beside him.
shots.video: 固定中景。深夜的维护舱里，阿牧独自坐着，面前是薄薄几页手写的纸，他一只手贴在身旁的管道上，另一只手翻过一页。环境声：风扇声、纸页翻动声。
shots.vo: 那一夜，他把网络的规则从头到尾抄了一遍。只有几页。

tpl.summary: Late at night in the cramped communications bay, Amu sits alone at the workbench and turns a page of his thin handwritten stack while one hand rests on a steel pipe; there is no dialogue.

tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with the cramped bay walls and equipment in the background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: steady fan hum, paper pages rustling and turning

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: old Boye in the dim interview room, leaning forward with a faint stubborn smile, one palm turned up as if asking a question.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷摊开一只手掌，像在考采访者，自问自答，说到最后手掌往外一送，笑了一下。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 路是谁的？话是谁的？没人能说是我的。正因为不是谁的，谁都能走，谁都能说。

tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Boye's face and palm sharp, the dim room background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Medium shot in the glass-walled meeting room: Amu standing at the steel table, pushing the closed folder back toward the grey-haired official in the dark-blue coat, Governor Xing seated at the side watching him.

dialogue.line: 谢谢。这个署长，我不当。这张网，也不该有署长。

tpl.summary: In the glass-walled meeting room, Amu stands at the steel table and calmly pushes the closed folder back to the official while Governor Xing watches; the clip opens and ends on the single line "谢谢。这个署长，我不当。这张网，也不该有署长。"

dialogue.line: 那出了事，谁来负责？
每一步都有回执。谁做的，谁负责。

dialogue.line: 规则就这么几页。今天起公开，谁都能照着搭一张。

dialogue.line: 专员，我支持他。建议联合政府也接一个节点，和大家一样。

shots.vo: 当晚，规则原样发往全网。没有署名，没有版权，没有主人。

shots.vo: 此后，任何一座城、任何一支车队，都可以自己搭起一张网，再和别的网连上。

dialogue.line: 规则不属于任何一个人，所以才能属于所有人。

shots.vo: 自从木星危机那天起，它没有再说过一句话。

dialogue.line: 阿牧。你们放弃了统一调度。这是效率最低的方案。

shots.video: 采访固定机位。金老板往椅背上一靠，咧了咧嘴，粗声说完，朝镜头外摆了摆手。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 路是大伙儿的。我只管把货送到。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Boss Jin leans back in his metal chair and delivers his answer, opening and ending on the line "路是大伙儿的。我只管把货送到。", then waves toward off-camera.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin sits centre frame on a metal chair in the foreground, facing the lens; the dim interview room fills the background, with no other figures visible.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Boss Jin sits forward in the metal chair, his black surface suit with the fur collar open, facing the lens.
tpl.middle: He leans back against the chair back and his mouth stretches into a half grin.
tpl.end: He lifts one hand and waves it toward the space beyond the camera.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Jin sharp, dim room background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Researcher Zhou, a Chinese woman with a low ponytail and thin wire glasses, in her white uniform with blue stripes, pen behind her ear, sitting in the dim interview room with a small warm smile.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。周研究员沉稳地说，说到后半句时露出一点笑意，轻轻点了下头。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 我后来去了敦煌。见到了那个声音。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Researcher Zhou calmly recounts a trip, opening with "我后来去了敦煌。" and ending on "见到了那个声音。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Researcher Zhou sits at frame centre in the dim interview room, facing the camera, with the dark room softly behind her and no other people in frame.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Researcher Zhou sits upright and composed, her gaze steady toward the camera, her expression calm with a faint warmth.
tpl.middle: She continues in a steady, measured manner, her face slowly softening as a small smile begins to form.
tpl.end: The smile settles on her face and she gives a gentle nod, then holds still, looking toward the camera.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with the dim room background softly out of focus and her face sharp.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Governor Xing in her charcoal uniform in the dim interview room, posture upright, hands open and relaxed on her knees.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。邢总督摊开原本交叠的双手，措辞依旧严谨，神情却松了下来。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 我守的是这座城的人，不是哪一套系统。这张网，我放心。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Governor Xing relaxes her guarded posture as she delivers a single line, opening with "我守的是这座城的人，不是哪一套系统。" and ending on "这张网，我放心。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing sits centre frame, upright in her charcoal uniform, with her open hands on her knees at the lower edge of frame and the dim, empty interview room behind her.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off interview camera, no movement.
tpl.start: Governor Xing sits upright with her hands still overlapped in front of her, her expression formal and controlled.
tpl.middle: She draws her overlapped hands apart and spreads them open, her shoulders easing slightly while her posture stays upright.
tpl.end: Her hands rest open and relaxed on her knees, and her face has softened into a calm, settled look.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with her face and hands in sharp focus and the dim room behind her softly blurred.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: old Boye in his navy quilted jacket in the dim interview room, taking off his taped glasses, eyes crinkled.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷摘下眼镜，眯着眼笑了，慢慢地说完，把眼镜折好放进棉袄口袋。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 这一回，钥匙没交出去。我睡得着了。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, old Boye takes off his taped glasses, smiles with crinkled eyes and says '这一回，钥匙没交出去。我睡得着了。', then folds the glasses into his jacket pocket.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye in his navy quilted jacket sits at frame centre facing slightly off-camera, dim interview room behind him, no one else in frame.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Boye raises a hand and slowly lifts his taped glasses from his face, eyes beginning to crinkle.
tpl.middle: Holding the glasses, he squints and smiles warmly, his expression softening as he takes his time.
tpl.end: He carefully folds the glasses closed and slips them into the pocket of his navy quilted jacket.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, dim room background softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Xiaoman in his oversized army-green jacket, headphones around his neck, grinning, sitting sideways on the metal chair in the dim interview room.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。小满歪坐在椅子上，嘴快地说完，自己先乐了，抬手指了指镜头外的门口。环境声：安静的房间底噪，门外隐约传来履带电机声。

dialogue.line: 太阳我没见过。可笑脸，我天天见。

tpl.summary: In the dim interview room, Xiaoman sits sideways on a metal chair and answers the interviewer, opening and closing on the line "太阳我没见过。可笑脸，我天天见。", then laughs and points toward the door off-camera.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman sits at frame centre, angled sideways on the metal chair, facing the interviewer off-camera; the dim interview room fills the background, with the door implied off-frame.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Xiaoman sits slouched sideways on the metal chair in his oversized army-green jacket, headphones around his neck, a cheeky grin already on his face.
tpl.middle: He leans slightly forward, animated and quick, then breaks into laughter, amused at his own answer.
tpl.end: Still grinning, he lifts one hand and points toward the doorway beyond the edge of the frame.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, Xiaoman sharp, dim room background softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint tracked-motor hum from outside the door

shots.frame: Interview close-up: Amu in the dim interview room, unclipping the small lavalier microphone from the collar of his orange-grey coverall, a faint self-mocking smile.
shots.video: 采访固定机位，近景。阿牧想了想，短短地说完，带着一点自嘲的笑意低头去摘领口的话筒。环境声：安静的房间底噪、话筒的轻微摩擦声。

dialogue.line: 网还在。不是我的。这样最好。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Amu pauses to think, then delivers a short answer, opening with "网还在。" and ending on "这样最好。", before lowering his head with a self-mocking smile to unclip his microphone.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu sits at frame centre in the dim interview room, facing the camera in his orange-grey coverall, with the lavalier microphone at his collar and a dark, empty background behind him.
tpl.camera: close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Amu sits still, eyes slightly unfocused, thinking over the question before he answers.
tpl.middle: He finishes his short answer, a faint self-mocking smile settling on his face.
tpl.end: He lowers his head and reaches to unclip the small lavalier microphone from his collar.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Amu sharp, dim room background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint rustle of the microphone rubbing against fabric

shots.frame: Extreme wide high-angle shot over the ice plain at night: a line of planetary engine beams receding to the horizon, each a blue-white column, scattered convoy headlights threading between them across the ice.
shots.video: 高机位大远景，极缓慢横摇。冰原上一道道发动机光柱排向地平线，光柱之间有车队的灯火像细线一样来回穿行。环境声：遥远而平稳的轰鸣、风声。
shots.vo: 一万台发动机，三十五亿人。没有一个大脑。有一张网。

tpl.summary: At night on the ice plain, a line of blue-white planetary engine beams recedes to the horizon while convoy headlights thread between them; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: engine beams stand in a receding line from foreground to the horizon across the frame, with small convoy headlights moving in the gaps between the columns, and no people visible.
tpl.camera: extreme wide high-angle shot, very slow pan from a high vantage point
tpl.start: The frame opens on the ice plain with the nearest blue-white engine beams standing tall and a few convoy headlights creeping between them.
tpl.middle: The camera pans slowly across the plain, revealing more beams stretching toward the horizon as the headlight lines weave back and forth like thin threads.
tpl.end: The pan settles on the farthest beams at the horizon, with the convoy lights still threading through the gaps in the distance.
tpl.blur: deep focus across the plain, with only the farthest horizon softening slightly into haze
tpl.soundscape: distant steady rumble, wind

shots.frame: Wide sky shot from the ice plain: Jupiter far behind, shrunk to a small pale golden disc among the stars, a faint glowing trail around it, the dark curve of the horizon below.
shots.video: 固定大远景，极缓慢后拉。星空里的木星已经缩成一枚小小的淡金色圆点，还在一点点变小。环境声：风声。
shots.vo: 前面的路，还有两千五百年。

tpl.summary: On the ice plain, the night sky holds a small pale golden Jupiter among the stars, shrinking steadily as the camera drifts away; no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Jupiter's small pale golden disc sits in the upper background centre among the stars, with the dark curve of the horizon along the bottom of the frame; no characters present.
tpl.camera: extreme wide shot, locked-off frame with a very slow pull-back
tpl.start: Jupiter hangs as a small pale golden disc in the star field, a faint glowing trail around it, above the dark horizon curve.
tpl.middle: The camera eases back almost imperceptibly and the golden disc continues to shrink bit by bit against the stars.
tpl.end: Jupiter is reduced to a tiny pale golden point in the vast starry sky above the dark horizon.
tpl.blur: Deep focus; stars and horizon are sharp, with only a soft glow haloing the planet.
tpl.soundscape: wind

shots.frame: Close-up of a cabin windowsill in the underground city at night: a small handmade node box made from an old ammunition tin with a short antenna and a red-and-white smiley sticker on its lid, one green indicator light on, a child's chalk drawing propped beside it, the warm blurred lights of other cabin windows beyond the glass.
shots.video: 特写固定镜头，极缓慢推近。窗台上的节点盒亮着一盏小绿灯，一下、一下地闪，窗外远处无数舱窗的灯火虚化成一片，其中也有小灯在同样地闪。环境声：轻微的提示音、远处地下城的安静底噪。
shots.vo: 开放，可验证，生而为了记住。它不属于任何一个人。

tpl.summary: On a cabin windowsill in the underground city at night, a small handmade node box blinks its green light while distant cabin lights glow beyond the glass; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the ammunition-tin node box with antenna and smiley sticker sits at frame centre on the windowsill, the child's chalk drawing leans beside it at frame left, and the blurred cabin window lights fill the background.
tpl.camera: macro close-up, locked-off camera with an extremely slow push-in
tpl.start: The node box sits still on the windowsill, its single green indicator light blinking steadily against the blurred glow of the distant windows.
tpl.middle: The camera creeps closer as the green light keeps pulsing, and far among the blurred cabin lights a few small lights blink in the same rhythm.
tpl.end: The frame settles tight on the node box, its green light still blinking, with the chalk drawing at the edge and the distant lights soft behind it.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field: the node box is sharp while the chalk drawing edge and the distant cabin window lights melt into soft bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: faint soft notification beeps, quiet low background hum of the distant underground city
